question: Can the pre-2026-09-12 memory be backfilled with source_agent_id, on the assumption that only one agent was writing?
verdict: CLOSED — nothing to backfill. The assumption is falsified in both directions. The mechanism is NOT proven unnecessary; it is simply untested by historical data (the target set is empty).

pg.metadata_producer_interpretation: Component name, NOT an agent identity. No agent-dimension provenance exists anywhere in the historical raw events.

json_snapshot_agreeing.note: Same counts as PG; used only as corroboration, not as the basis of the verdict.

window.important_scope_note: Top-level sessions date back to 2026-09-06, but they produced NO memory-module data. The entire 'pre-2026-09-12 history' is this 18-hour block of acceptance/probe activity.

assumption_falsified.claim_under_test: 'Only one agent was writing during that period', the sole basis on which a backfill could be justified.
assumption_falsified.direction_1_literal: FALSE — 42 distinct callerAgentId, 51 distinct sessions.agentId, 87 agent records in the window.
assumption_falsified.direction_2_attributable: FALSE — raw events carry no agent dimension (producer is a component name), and the 87 agent records are largely indistinguishable by name (49x '验收助手', 22x '面板验收'), all created inside one 18-hour span.
assumption_falsified.shape_inference: Consistent with an acceptance/probe harness repeatedly recreating agents, not with genuine concurrent multi-agent writing.
assumption_falsified.inference_confidence: REASONABLE BUT NOT FULLY PROVEN — the recreation script was not traced line by line. Flagged as unverified.

counterfactual.method: Directed mutation on a /tmp copy. No project file was modified.

results.mutation: remove the C-15 read-side source filter

counterfactual.interpretation: The 2b mechanism is live and effective. Leakage is real for untagged data; there is simply no untagged data to leak, because the assertion table is empty.
counterfactual.explicit_caution: This must NOT be reported as 'the isolation problem is solved'. The correct meaning is: the isolation mechanism has not yet been exercised by historical data.

consequence.todo_closed: The 'backfill historical provenance' item is CLOSED, not deferred. Leaving an unexecutable todo in the record is itself a form of documentation rot.
consequence.normalised_statement: …memory isolation: relationship/life scopes are isolated by owner; new data is additionally isolated by origin (2b); historical data contains no assertions requiring origin isolation (assertion tables empty, historical raw events carry no agent origin, and all of it originated from acceptance/probe activity over an ~18-hour window).
consequence.forbidden_statement: Do not state that the origin-isolation problem has disappeared.
consequence.forward_obligation: Any future assertion must still be written through the C-13 tagging path, or the window described in promotion-statement §7 reappears in a form the instruments cannot detect.

residual_uncertainty: The harness-recreation shape inference is unverified (see above).
